INTERNSHIP
Quality Intern, Chakan Precision Components, Pune (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025, 8 weeks)
- Measured shaft and bush dimensions with vernier calipers, micrometers and bore gauges on the machining line.
- Carried out in-process inspection and final inspection of turned parts before dispatch.
- Read engineering drawings with GD&T callouts to check tolerances on brackets.

PROJECTS
- Reducing burr defects (final-year project): Used a fishbone diagram and 5 whys to find causes of burr defects on drilled flanges with the shop-floor team.
- Jig design (academic, Machine Design course): Designed a drilling jig in SolidWorks and made its 2D drawing.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Metrology and Quality Control, Manufacturing Processes, Engineering Drawing, Industrial Engineering
- Certificate in Quality Management Basics (NPTEL)

SKILLS
Vernier caliper, Micrometer, Height gauge, Engineering drawing, AQL sampling, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, MS Excel

ACTIVITIES
- SAE BAJA team, manufacturing subsystem
- Blood donation camp volunteer
